verdict.rationale: Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister is a public register service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only web search, publication and portal features, and an llms.txt probe returned 404. Nothing shows an official MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
